myPlan.title: My schedule
myPlan.intro: Your own assignments, absences and qualifications. Read-only — changes are made by whoever plans the work.
myPlan.notLinkedTitle: Account not linked to a person yet
myPlan.notLinkedBody: This account is not linked to a scheduled person, so there is nothing to show here. An administrator makes the link in user management. This is not the same as "nothing scheduled".
myPlan.loadFailed: The schedule could not be loaded.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Subtitle
settings.subtitleDesc: Optional text below the company name.
settings.logoUrlDesc: URL to an image (PNG/SVG). Displayed as a 36×36 icon in the header.
settings.logoUploadDesc: Upload an image file (PNG, JPEG, SVG, WebP, GIF; max 2 MB). Overrides the URL if set.
settings.primaryColorDesc: Accent color for buttons, links, and active elements.
settings.defaultsDesc: These values serve as defaults. Language and color scheme can be changed at any time via the header icons.
settings.defaultLanguageDesc: Default language for the user interface.
settings.auditRetentionDesc: Entries older than this are deleted. 0 means keep everything.
settings.auditRetentionJobHint: Deletion is performed by a recurring backend job. With no job scheduled, nothing is deleted regardless of this value.
settings.baselineRetentionDesc: 0 keeps everything and is the default — unlike the audit log, because a baseline was created deliberately. The baseline marked as reference is never deleted.
settings.planningFreezeDesc: First day that may still be edited. Changes to assignments before it are refused — including moving one out of the frozen period, and deleting one. Only administrators can still change it, and that is recorded in the audit log. Leave empty for no freeze.
settings.schedulerEnabledDesc: Checks capacity conflicts every 15 minutes and cleans audit logs and baselines daily according to retention settings. Checks immediately after edits and imports always remain active.
settings.maintenanceHourDesc: Hour in the server's timezone, normally UTC. A missed day is made up once on the next start, not once per missed day.

absences.title: Absences
absences.statusDesc: Both statuses reduce capacity identically. The status only says what is still negotiable — treating a requested holiday as free capacity produces plans that break at approval.

form.linkedPersonHelp: Links this account to a scheduled person. Only then does that person see their own assignments, absences and qualifications under "My schedule". Clearing the field removes the link.
form.resetPasswordHelp: Fill in only to set a new password. The person must replace it themselves at next login. Leave empty to change nothing.

admin.title: Master data
admin.peopleCsvHint: CSV format: Name; Group; [Skill; Attribute]. Skill columns are optional. Skills are auto-created if missing.
admin.infrastructureCsvHint: CSV format: Name; Group; [Skill; Attribute]. Skill columns are optional. Skills are auto-created if missing.
admin.projectsCsvHint: CSV format: Project; Start; End; Work Package; WP Start; WP End; [Skill; Attribute; Quantity]. Skill columns are optional. Skills must already exist.
admin.templatesCsvHint: CSV format: Template; Description; Skill; Attribute; Quantity. Skills must already exist.
admin.assignmentsCsvHint: CSV format: Project; Work Package; Resource; Start; End; Allocation. The Work Package column is optional (otherwise resolved by date overlap). Resources and projects must already exist. Dates in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

projectForm.positionDesc: Order within the folder, e.g. the sequence units are worked in.
projectForm.externalRefDesc: Identifier from your own system, e.g. a serial or asset number.
projectForm.committedDeliveryDesc: What was promised to the customer. Leave empty if nothing was — that is not the same as being on time.
projectForm.priorityDesc: Urgency across projects — independent of the order within a folder.
projectForm.customerInherited: Inherited from the folder: {name}. Fill in only if this project differs.

sites.hint: A site owns the holiday calendar. Because public holidays differ per location, which site a resource belongs to changes what its capacity actually is.
sites.name: Name
sites.regionCodeDesc: Used only by the holiday import script, e.g. DE-BY. Never read at runtime.
sites.isDefaultDesc: Resources without a site fall back to this one. Exactly one site carries the flag.

profiles.hint: Part-time and shift patterns live here, not in absences. A part-time employee is not absent, and an absence cannot express a weekday shape.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.isDefaultDesc: Resources without a binding fall back to this profile. Without one, a fresh install reports zero capacity everywhere.
profiles.deleteError: Could not delete the profile. It may still be assigned to resources.

holidays.hint: A calendar exception overrides the week profile for one day. 0:00 means non-working, a value below the profile a half day, and a value above 0 on a free day a designated working Saturday.
holidays.name: Label
holidays.workingHoursDesc: 0:00 for a non-working day, e.g. 4:00 for a half day.
holidays.empty: No exceptions recorded for this year.

folders.title: Folders
folders.empty: No folders yet. Grouping is optional.
folders.parentDesc: Leave empty for the top level.
folders.positionDesc: Orders this folder among its siblings.
folders.deleteKeepsContents: Projects inside are kept and become unfiled. Sub-folders move up one level. Nothing is deleted along with it.
folders.deleted: {projects} project(s) are now unfiled, {subfolders} sub-folder(s) moved.
folders.externalRefDesc: The folder's own identifier, e.g. the order number. The unit's own reference lives on the project.

windows.title: Operating hours — {name}
windows.emptyMeansAlwaysAvailable: With no operating hours defined the resource counts as available around the clock. The first window is therefore a restriction, not a release.
windows.wrapsHint: The end time is before the start time, so the window runs past midnight. The hours after midnight belong to the starting day: a holiday on the start day cancels the whole shift.
windows.multipleShiftsHint: Several windows on the same weekday express multi-shift operation, e.g. 06:00–14:00 and 14:00–22:00 as two entries.
windows.equalTimes: Start and end time must differ.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.purposeNote: Records who changed which planning data and when. Its purpose is traceability of plan changes. Access is restricted to administrators, and there is no way to output every entry at once.
audit.retentionNote: Entries are deleted after {months} months. Deletion is performed by a recurring backend job.
audit.retentionUnlimited: No retention period is set (0 = keep everything). The period can be changed in the settings.
audit.entityTypeDesc: Table name, e.g. projects or assignments.
audit.entityHistoryHint: A single entity's history can be fetched by its type and id.
audit.entityIdDesc: Together with the entity type, fetches that one entity's history.
audit.loadFailed: Could not load the audit log

baselines.title: Baselines
baselines.markerNotLock: A baseline records what the plan looked like at a point in time. It does NOT lock the plan — editing stays possible. A hard freeze would only move the next change into a spreadsheet, where nobody can see it.
baselines.nameDesc: What this baseline stands for, e.g. "Customer sign-off ORD-4711" or "Week 34".
baselines.noteDesc: Optional remark, e.g. what this baseline is based on.
baselines.makeCurrentDesc: The plan will be compared against this baseline by default.
baselines.noDrift: The plan is unchanged against this baseline.
baselines.changed: Changed — the agreed plan has moved
baselines.deleteKeepsPlan: The current plan is untouched. Only the frozen comparison point is lost.

workProfiles.title: Week profile — {name}
workProfiles.validFromDesc: The profile applies from this day.
workProfiles.resolutionOrder: The first matching assignment applies: the individual one, then the group, then the parent group, otherwise the default profile.
workProfiles.fallbackDefault: The default profile currently applies, since there is neither an individual nor a group assignment.
workProfiles.datedHint: Assignments are dated rather than replaced. A contract change on 1 July is a new assignment from that day, so the capacity of past periods stays unchanged.

dependencies.title: Dependencies — {name}
dependencies.explainer: A dependency means the predecessor must finish before this package may start. A lag of 0 means the next working day, not the same day. Dates are not moved by this — contradictions are reported, not corrected.

digest.title: Needs attention
digest.allClearDetail: Within the configured horizon no qualification expires, no commitment is uncovered and no dependency is violated.
digest.truncatedDetail: The cap is configurable in settings.

dependency_violated.title: {successor} starts too early
dependency_violated.detailOne: after {predecessor}; one working day too early

maintenance.title: Recent maintenance runs
maintenance.neverRanDetail: While no run is recorded, nothing has been deleted — the retention periods above are an intention, not a state.

teamWeek.loadFailed: Could not load the team week
teamWeek.noPeople: No people are assigned to this group.
teamWeek.noGroups: No personnel groups have been created.

reports.title: Reports
reports.projectsHint: All projects with commitments, violations and progress.

mail.title: Email delivery (SMTP)
mail.notSendingYet: The configuration is saved and validated, but nothing is sent yet. Delivery of the digest follows as a separate step.
mail.incomplete: Configuration incomplete — nothing would be sent
mail.enabledDesc: Off while nothing is configured. Active means the configuration is validated and would be ready to use.
mail.useTlsDesc: Usual on port 587. Turn off for implicit TLS on 465 and change the port too.
mail.usernameDesc: Leave empty if the relay authenticates by IP.
mail.passwordStored: A password is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
mail.recipientsDesc: Separate multiple addresses with commas, semicolons or line breaks.

customers.title: Customers
customers.name: Name
customers.duplicate: A customer with this name already exists.
customers.empty: No customers yet. The customer is set on the folder and inherited by every project inside it.
customers.deleteConfirm: Delete the customer \u201c{name}\u201d? The link is removed from {folders} folder(s) and {projects} project(s); the projects themselves are kept.
customers.retireHint: Retiring instead of deleting keeps the customer on existing projects and only removes it from pickers.

projectFolder.customerDesc: Applies to every project in this folder and in sub-folders that name no customer of their own.

conflictCheck.failed: Last check failed; an automatic retry will follow
conflictCheck.importFailed: Import saved. The subsequent conflict check failed. The periodic reconciliation will retry if enabled.
conflictCheck.importResult: Conflict check completed: {count} capacity conflicts for the checked resources
